slot_scores.name: demand_fulfillment_required
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the market demand for each container type a minimum that must be met (i.e., total production allocated to that demand type must be at least the stated demand), or is it an exact target that must be met precisely?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be met, covering the full-demand requirement.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize total cost (fixed setup costs plus variable production costs), and is there any upper bound on total production capacity or on the production quantity of each container type?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about minimizing total cost including both fixed and variable components.
